column1: # Key: grid H, written in the period key book HHStAW Abt. 171 Nr. C 667, image 55 (upper grid, "1620"; SHA-256 902468e5... of key_H.json).
# A letter is the shape of its cell in the grid AKT|BLV|CMW / DNX|EOY|FPZ / GQ|HR|IS; 0, 1 or 2 dots give its 1st, 2nd or 3rd letter.
# u and v are one letter (v). Nomenclator ("Vocabula" with dots, "Allerhand wörter" with symbols) on the same page: not resolved;
# the list of capitals (C 667 images 20-54) was not seen. The second grid of the page (IS|FPZ|CMW / HR|EOY|BLV / GQ|DNX|AKT) serves the 1606/1609 letters.
